name: Moozo Core API
description:
The Moozo Core API powers the Moozo Student Data Platform — a multi-tenant SaaS
application for Ugandan schools.

## Authentication

Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT token obtained via one of the login endpoints.
Include it in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Access tokens expire after **15 minutes**. Use the refresh endpoint to obtain a
new one without re-entering credentials.

## Multi-Tenancy

Every school has its own isolated database schema. The server determines which
school schema to query from the JWT (`schoolId` claim) on authenticated requests.

For unauthenticated requests from a web browser, the school is resolved from the
subdomain (e.g. `kitante.moozo.ug`).

For unauthenticated requests from the mobile app, the `schoolId` is submitted
in the request body.

## School Codes

Every school is assigned a permanent **school code** at registration (e.g. `KIT001`).
This code never changes even if the school renames or changes its slug.

## Response Envelope

All responses follow a consistent envelope:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { }
}
```

Errors follow:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "errors": [
    { "field": "email", "message": "must not be blank", "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR" }
  ]
}
```

Paginated responses:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [ ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 0,
    "size": 20,
    "totalElements": 45,
    "totalPages": 3
  }
}
```
